name: Bönen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bönen (a red chain link on white).
history: The arms were granted together with the flag and the seal by the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia on 18 April 1969; the hoisted flag is divided red and white with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Bönen arms — red chain link on white
